issues.description: Constructor parameter mismatch: the template Main.java (starter code) instantiates Seal, Pig, and Goat with two constructor arguments (e.g. new Seal("Clarabelle", "marine")), while the problem specification's UML and the solution implementation define Animal subclasses with a single-argument constructor (name only). This discrepancy can confuse students about the required constructors and cause compilation errors if they follow the template Main examples.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template Main.java consistent with the UML and solution by using single-argument constructors for animals (e.g. new Seal("Clarabelle"), new Pig("Doodle"), new Goat("Buttinsky")), or alternatively update the problem statement and solution to specify and implement two-argument constructors for the animal subclasses. Preferably adjust the template Main to the one-argument form to match the UML (Animal only has a name).
